d_tariff.title: "D" (dynamic) tariff — what if…
d_tariff.description: Estimates what the already imported consumption would cost on the announced dynamic (HUPX-based) "D" tariff and compares it to the current (A1) price. 15-minute day-ahead prices are downloaded from api.energy-charts.info (plus MNB daily rates when the rate is set to 0) — the only place this integration uses the network. The final "D" tariff terms are not public yet, so every fee is editable (defaults are the current best estimates). Formula: (HUPX EUR/MWh × EUR/HUF ÷ 1000 + merchant + transmission + distribution fee) × (1 + VAT%).

data.d_eur_huf: EUR/HUF rate (0 = MNB daily rate, fetched automatically)

folder.title: Import directory
folder.description: The directory the integration scans for *.csv files. On recent HaOS the config folder is reached at `/homeassistant` (not `/config`), e.g. `/homeassistant/mvm_next`. Saving re-runs the import.

pricing.title: Cost calculation
pricing.description: Alongside consumption an `mvm_next:imported_cost` statistic is pushed in the currency configured in Home Assistant (set it to HUF). Tiered household tariff: the reduced unit price up to the yearly allowance, the market price above it. The allowance resets every calendar year. If you set the contract start date, consumption before it (the previous customer's) is excluded and that year's allowance is prorated. Saving re-computes every past import.

data.price_high: Market price above the allowance (HUF/kWh, gross)

upload.title: Upload MVM Next CSV
upload.description: Pick the downloaded MVM Next CSV export file. It is stored under a name based on the period it covers (e.g. `mvm_2026-08.csv`) so it never overwrites an earlier export, and the statistic is refreshed immediately.
